name: Caterpillar
overview: The Bible portrays the caterpillar as an instrument of God's judgment, often depicted alongside locusts and other destructive insects sent to consume and bring devastation. Scriptures such as Psalms 78:46 and Joel 1:4 illustrate how caterpillars are part of a divine army that devours the produce of the land, symbolizing the consequences of disobedience. Jeremiah 51:27 and Joel 2:25 further emphasize the purposeful use of these creatures to execute God's will and the promise of restoration following such judgments.
